payload.summary: One private conversation changes who is trusted with the plan.
payload.body: One private conversation changes who is trusted with the plan. Mercury conjunct Pluto can bring missing money, withheld information, or an undisclosed agreement into the same moment as the decision about what happens next. Once the hidden arrangement is named, access and loyalty are no longer abstract questions. Preserve the record before the conversation gets rewritten afterward. Ask who knew, who approved, and who had something to gain from keeping the information private.
